description:
Construction of a single-storey rear and side infill extension. The proposed extension would extend approximately 3 metres in length at the rear and approximately 5.26 metres in width. In addition the proposal includes a fill in extension to the side of the property currently occupied by a lean to. (Written Advice only)

There are no trees or bushes in the area proposed for the extension rear and infill extension. 
The development would be constructed in materials to match the existing dwelling, including brickwork, and would feature a flat roof design incorporating roof lights to provide natural daylight. Bi-folding doors are proposed to the rear elevation to enhance light and access to the garden.
The proposed extension will create a larger open-plan kitchen, dining and living space. No changes to the use of the property are proposed, and no additional alterations to the existing building are included as part of this application.
Total sq.m of floor space	Approx 3 x 5.26 metres rear extension, plus side infill extension 
Written advice (only)	£400	£80	£480
